title: Data table
description: A table that sorts, filters, selects and pages rows on the client, built on Table: give it rows and columns, it keeps the state (or you control it).
when: Admin lists: orders, customers, inventory, logs — sort by a column, search, act on several rows.
Many columns on a tablet or beside a rail: give the less important ones a `priority`, they fold into the first column instead of being cut.

instead.need: A static table with no interaction

instead.use: control sort / page, pass the current page's rows

a11y: Sortable headers are buttons with aria-sort on the header cell; the caption names the table; row checkboxes and select-all are labelled; aria-busy while loading.

A folded value keeps its header for screen readers (“Nguồn: Facebook”) on the first cell's second line; when the table still scrolls sideways its scroll box is a named, focusable region, so the arrow keys scroll it.

examples.title: Many columns: priority folds, sticky first column
examples.description: Switch the width: at Máy tính bảng the priority 3 columns fold under the name; at Hẹp the priority 2 ones too, and the columns without a priority scroll sideways with the name kept in place and a strong line on the edge that has more columns.

notes: Folding is measured on the table's own box (not the viewport), from each column's one-line width: a table in a split view or next to the rail folds as soon as it is too narrow. Folding happens after hydration: the server HTML shows every column, so a table with priorities may shift once on first load at tablet width.

The order the table shows is `sortRows(searchRows(rows, columns, search), columns, sort)` (or read it from `onResultsChange`): use it to step through the results in a DetailOverlay (‹ ›, “n / N”), see the detail-overlay docs.
Pass `activeRowId` to highlight the open record's row (`bg-item-selected`, `aria-current="true"`); checked rows use `bg-item-checked`.

A table wider than its box draws a 2px strong line (outline-line) on each edge that has columns past it (in every table; with `stickyFirstColumn` the left line is the pinned column's edge) and keeps the first column (and the checkbox column) in place with `stickyFirstColumn`; the table then sits on `bg-card`. The sorted column never folds: its header is the only sort control.
